Added unit tests for the point inclusion table, the three-piece point exclusion and the cell partition.

Labelled the largest-gap tie-break DESIGN with its reason; redirected the superseded N25c-19 to N19c-05 and named N25e-38/N25e-39 as owners of the shared-nuisance rule and the four-law probe; recorded the milestone conflict with the verb registry (M4 there, M3 here).
